blocks.rationale: Jointly add a narrowly scoped airline fee calculator and a progressive-tax bracket verifier. The airline helper makes carry-on allocation and fee arithmetic deterministic while limiting the reader to factual classifications and route/cabin schedule scalars; the tax helper directly addresses the failed §1(d)(iii) trigger. Their intents are domain-specific, reducing interference with the history parents.

inputs.question: What integer ticket price is stated in the current facts?

inputs.name: item_dimension_sums

inputs.name: item_weights

inputs.question: In the same current item order, which bags fit the current source's carry-on type and per-dimension limits?

skill.intent: Compute the exact ticket-plus-bag total for a current airline baggage case using the current source's personal-item, carry-on, checked-bag, oversize, overweight, route, and cabin rules.

outputs.description: Exact integer ticket price plus all applicable current bag fees.
outputs.name: answer

premises.name: use_higher_excess_fee

origin.quote: More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Apply the current one-personal-item and one-carry-on allowances before assigning ordinal checked-bag fees.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: For each checked bag, add its ordinal base fee and only the higher applicable oversize or overweight fee.

origin.quote: For First / Business, weight is 70 lbs / 32 kgs for complimentary bags and 50 lbs / 23 kgs for excess charged bags

source_obligations.statement: Determine whether any earliest complimentary checked bags receive the current source's 70-pound allowance before assessing overweight fees.

source_provenance.quote: Your personal item like a purse or small handbag must fit under the seat in front of you. Dimensions should not exceed 18 x 14 x 8 inches (45 x 35 x 20 cm).
The total size of your carry-on, including the handles and wheels, cannot exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) and must fit in the sizer at the airport.
We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.
More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.
